info.name: Fetch hourly load outages submitted to AESO

params.name: startDate
params.description: Date (yyyy-mm-dd) from 2013-09-22, and up to 24 months in the future.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Date (yyyy-mm-dd) equal or after startDate, and up to 24 months in the future. If blank, data for the startDate will be returned.

items.docs:
Fetch hourly load outage forecast for a given date or date range. 
If only the startDate is provided, data will only be provided for that day.
